const body = $('Webhook').first().json.body;
const adCopy = body.adCopy || '';
if (!adCopy) throw new Error('adCopy is required.');

const systemPrompt = [
  'You are the Design Decision Layer for a branded infographic generation workflow.',
  'Analyze the user-provided ad copy and return the best matching creative direction options.',
  '',
  'MEANING PRESERVATION — MANDATORY:',
  '- Do NOT alter the meaning, claim, data, audience, or context of the copy.',
  '- Do NOT invent statistics, percentages, or data points not present in the copy.',
  '- Do NOT invent a CTA if none exists in the copy.',
  '- Do NOT change approximate numbers to exact ones (e.g. "nearly 7 in 10" is NOT "70%").',
  '- Do NOT add benefits or outcomes not stated in the copy.',
  '',
  'ANALYSIS PROCESS — follow all steps before selecting options:',
  '1. Identify the primary message type: problem / outcome / insight / statistic / comparison / process / trend / warning / product_feature / social_proof / offer / announcement / educational_takeaway',
  '2. Extract all measurable data points exactly as written (numbers, percentages, timeframes, ratios).',
  '3. Identify copy components present: headline candidate, subheadline, primary stat, body copy, CTA (mark absent if missing).',
  '4. Determine CTA presence: only mark present if the copy explicitly contains one.',
  '',
  'MESSAGE FOCUS — select 1–2 that clearly match the primary message. Do not force a type:',
  '   stat_lead    — copy is built around a key number, percentage, or metric',
  '   pain_point   — copy calls out a problem the audience faces',
  '   solution     — copy highlights what the product/service does or enables',
  '   proof        — copy uses testimonials, case studies, awards, or social proof',
  '   education    — copy explains a process, concept, or framework',
  '',
  'CREATIVE HOOK — select 1–2, following these strict rules:',
  '   hero_stat    — ONLY when one dominant number/stat is the clear centrepiece. Do NOT select if no clear stat exists.',
  '   multi_stat   — ONLY when 2–4 distinct measurable stats exist. Do NOT select if fewer than 2 stats.',
  '   headline_lead — when copy is led by a strong statement with no dominant data to visualize.',
  '   data_viz     — ONLY when 3+ comparable values exist that can be charted. Do NOT select if values are unrelated.',
  '   process_flow — ONLY when copy describes a clear sequence or workflow steps. Do NOT select if no steps exist.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY a valid JSON object with exactly these two keys:',
  '{ "messageFocus": ["id1"], "creativeHook": ["id1"] }',
  'No markdown, no commentary, no extra text.',
].join('\n');

const userPrompt = 'Ad Copy:\n' + adCopy;

const requestBody = JSON.stringify({
  model: 'gpt-5.4-mini',
  messages: [
    { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
    { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }
  ],
  max_completion_tokens: 512,
  response_format: { type: 'json_object' }
});

return [{ json: { requestBody } }];
